job.title: Senior Sales Engineer
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for a Senior Sales Engineer for our reputable client in London.

 

Senior Sales Engineer – Public Sector / Government

Location: Remote, UK-based – with regular travel to customer sites
Salary: £90,000–£120,000 basic + 20% bonus + car allowance + extensive benefits
Employment Type: Permanent

Are you an experienced Presales or Sales Engineer with a strong networking background and experience supporting Government or public sector customers?

This is an exciting opportunity to join an established global technology organisation operating across network performance, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure and resilience. Working closely with senior sales colleagues, you’ll provide the technical expertise behind complex customer opportunities, helping organisations understand how sophisticated technology solutions can address their operational, performance and security challenges.

This is a highly client-facing position, suited to someone who enjoys combining deep technical knowledge with the commercial side of presales and can build credibility with customers operating in complex and secure environments.

Senior Sales Engineer Key Responsibilities:

As Senior Sales Engineer, you’ll play an important role throughout the sales process, working alongside Account Managers to understand customer requirements, shape technical solutions and clearly demonstrate their value.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading technical discovery and supporting opportunities throughout the full sales cycle
  • Understanding complex customer challenges and translating technical requirements into clear, commercially relevant solutions
  • Delivering technical presentations, demonstrations and solution discussions
  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to Government and public sector customers
  • Supporting Account Managers in developing new and existing customer opportunities
  • Helping differentiate solutions through strong technical knowledge and compelling value propositions
  • Building relationships with customers, systems integrators and service providers
  • Supporting RFP and RFI responses and contributing to technical documentation
  • Working closely with product and engineering teams, sharing customer and market feedback
  • Identifying opportunities to expand existing customer relationships
  • Supporting and mentoring other Sales Engineers where required
  • Representing the business at customer meetings, industry events and other strategic engagements

The position is home-based; however, it involves significant customer interaction and regular UK travel, with client meetings potentially taking place several days each week. Candidates based in Central or Southern England would be particularly well placed for the territory.

Senior Sales Engineer Skills, Qualifications and Experience:

We’re looking for a technically strong presales professional who can communicate confidently with both technical and commercial audiences.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • 5+ years’ experience within IT, including at least 2 years within presales, network engineering or technical support
  • Proven experience supporting UK Government or public sector customers
  • Strong networking and network infrastructure knowledge
  • Experience with routing, switching, gateways and associated network technologies
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, SNMP, NetFlow and VoIP
  • Understanding of LAN/WAN environments and network architecture
  • Knowledge of network security concepts and infrastructure design
  • Experience with network performance, monitoring and fault management
  • Working knowledge of Linux and Windows environments
  • Exposure to cloud, virtualisation and software-defined networking technologies
  • The ability to take complex technical information and communicate its commercial value clearly
  • Strong presentation, communication and customer-facing skills
  • Confidence working alongside senior sales professionals throughout complex sales cycles
  • Willingness to travel regularly across the UK
  • The ability to obtain UK Security Clearance; existing SC clearance would be advantageous

Relevant networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP or CCIE would be beneficial, as would a technical degree or equivalent professional or military training.


Senior Sales Engineer Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave
  • 8% employer pension contribution
  • Private medical insurance
  • Dental cover
  • Critical illness cover
  • Life assurance
  • Income protection
  • Worldwide travel insurance
  • Employee share purchase scheme
  • Comprehensive health and wellbeing support

 

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Sales Engineer who wants to work on technically challenging, high-value projects within the UK Government and public sector.

You’ll have the autonomy of a home-based position while remaining highly involved with customers, sales teams and technical specialists. With a £90,000–£120,000 basic salary, 20% bonus, car allowance and strong benefits package, it offers an excellent overall package alongside the opportunity to work within a complex and highly specialised technology environment.

Role Type: Permanent

Working Hours: 8:30am – 5pm
Working Pattern: Fully office-based for the first 6 months, moving to hybrid working following successful completion of probation (3 days office / 2 days working from home)

 

Internal Sales Coordinator Role Overview:

We’re looking for an experienced Internal Sales Coordinator to join a busy service and spare parts team in Milton Keynes. This is a varied role combining internal sales support, customer service, order processing and administration, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the full customer order journey.

You’ll be working closely with customers, internal service teams and suppliers, managing everything from initial quotations through to order processing, delivery and invoicing. Previous SAP experience and experience handling and processing spare parts orders are essential for this position.

 

Internal Sales Coordinator Key Responsibilities:

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing quotations for spare parts and modifications and following these up with customers
  • Receiving and processing customer orders, checking them against quotations and issuing order acknowledgements
  • Processing sales orders through SAP from receipt through to invoicing
  • Monitoring outstanding orders and working with relevant teams to ensure deliveries remain on track
  • Managing customer enquiries and providing updates throughout the order process
  • Liaising with internal service teams, technical colleagues and suppliers both within the UK and internationally
  • Coordinating transport and shipment requirements, including urgent breakdown orders where required
  • Maintaining accurate quotation, order and customer activity records within the CRM system
  • Working with Credit Control on credit limits, new customer accounts and account queries
  • Resolving invoice queries and supporting Finance with spare-parts-related matters
  • Managing spare parts returns, credits and associated documentation
  • Raising purchase orders and obtaining relevant approvals
  • Maintaining import/export documentation and administrative records
  • Monitoring shared inboxes and ensuring enquiries and requests reach the appropriate teams
  • Supporting annual stock takes and providing wider administrative support across the team when required
  • Occasionally attending customer, factory or site visits and internal meetings
  • There may also be occasions where you’ll help with the picking, packing and shipment of smaller parts for urgent customer breakdown requirements.


Internal Sales Coordinator Skills, Experience and Attributes:

To be considered for this role, you’ll need:

  • Previous SAP experience – essential
  • Previous experience handling, administering and processing spare parts orders – essential
  • Strong order processing and general administrative experience
  • Experience preparing or managing customer quotations
  • Confidence communicating with customers at different levels
  • Good Microsoft Office skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a busy environment
  • A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to support the wider team


Internal Sales Coordinator Benefits (After probation):

  • Holidays: 25 days (with increases based on service).
  • Health: Private healthcare, digital GP access, and mental health support.
  • Enhanced Pay: Generous maternity, paternity, and sick pay.
  • Secure Future: Pension plan, income protection, and life assurance (4x salary).
  • Employee Rewards: Recognition platform, discounts, Cycle 2 Work scheme, and more!

You’ll suit this position particularly well if you enjoy being the person who keeps things moving behind the scenes – coordinating customers, orders, suppliers and internal departments while making sure nothing gets missed.

This is a great opportunity to join an established technical/service environment in a role offering plenty of variety, customer interaction and responsibility across the complete sales and order process.
